about: List price per 1M input tokens (USD, base rate: standard tier, short-context, uncached, no batch, promotion or off-peak discount) from the maker's own price page, for every leaderboard or Did-they-improve model whose total parameter count model_params.json leaves undisclosed (closed models, and open models without a disclosed total). Ümit's JOB 2 FINAL (#4217): these models are classed by this price (Efficient <= $0.50, Workhorse > $0.50 to $3, Flagship > $3); open models with a disclosed total are classed by it (model_params.json). weights: open or closed. input_per_mtok null: no price on the maker's page for this model (never estimated); such a model has no class. read: the date the page was read.
